categories.name: Options

options.summary: Select tests, examples and fuzz seeds by name
options.detail: Use an unanchored regular expression. A slash separates subtest levels. A matching parent runs to discover its children, as in -run '^TestAPI$/^Read$'. The test binary spelling is -test.run.

options.summary: Run benchmarks matching a name pattern
options.detail: Benchmarks are off by default. Use -bench . for all benchmarks or -run '^$' -bench . to skip ordinary tests. A slash selects sub-benchmarks. The test binary spelling is -test.bench.

The default is one run. Explicit -count=1 bypasses cached test results. With -cpu the count applies to each setting. Examples run once and -fuzz targets ignore the count. The test binary spelling is -test.count.
options.summary: Repeat tests, benchmarks and fuzz seeds

options.detail: The binary panics after 10m by default. Supply a duration like 30s or 1m30s, or use 0 to disable the alarm. Some versions also disable it for negative unit-bearing durations. The test binary spelling is -test.timeout.
options.summary: Limit how long each test binary can run
Measure statement coverage
options.detail: By default each test measures its own package. Use -coverpkg to include other packages.

options.summary: Write statement coverage to a file
options.detail: Enables -cover. Read the profile with go tool cover, as in go tool cover -func=coverage.out. The test binary spelling is -test.coverprofile.

options.summary: Stream test events as JSON
options.detail: Includes verbose test output. Go 1.24 and later also emit build output and failures as JSON events. With Ubuntu 24.04’s default Go 1.22, build diagnostics can appear on stderr as text.

options.summary: Stop starting tests after the first failure
options.detail: Tests already running in parallel can finish. The test binary spelling is -test.failfast.

options.summary: Compile tests without running them
options.detail: Writes a package-named .test binary in the current directory. Use -o for a different filename or directory.

options.summary: Keep files created in test artifact directories
options.detail: Go 1.26 and later retain files created under testing.T.ArtifactDir and its benchmark and fuzz equivalents. Choose the parent directory with -outputdir. Earlier versions lack this flag. The test binary spelling is -test.artifacts.

options.summary: Set benchmark time or iterations
options.detail: Use a duration such as 1m30s or a decimal count ending in lowercase x, such as 100x, for each benchmark. The default is 1s. An explicit limit must be positive. The test binary spelling is -test.benchtime.

options.summary: Run tests at selected GOMAXPROCS values
options.detail: Pass positive decimal counts separated by commas, for example -cpu=1,2,4. Each setting runs the selected tests and benchmarks. Active fuzzing ignores this list. Empty components are skipped. The test binary spelling is -test.cpu.

options.summary: Show full source paths in test errors
options.detail: Use full filenames in test failure locations. The normal output shortens paths. The test binary spelling is -test.fullpath.

options.summary: Fuzz one matching target
options.detail: Supply a regular expression matching exactly one fuzz target in one package in the main module. Fuzzing begins after the selected tests, benchmarks, examples and seed cases. A failing input can be saved under testdata/fuzz. The test binary spelling is -test.fuzz.

options.summary: Limit fuzzing time or target calls
options.detail: Use a duration such as 1m30s or a decimal count ending in lowercase x, such as 100x, for the fuzzing run. The default is unlimited. An explicit limit must be positive. The test binary spelling is -test.fuzztime.

options.summary: Limit work per minimization attempt
options.detail: Use a duration such as 1m30s or a decimal count ending in lowercase x, such as 100x, for each minimization attempt. The default is 60s. Zero duration or 0x disables minimization. The test binary spelling is -test.fuzzminimizetime.

options.summary: List matching top-level cases
options.detail: List matching top-level tests, benchmarks, fuzz targets and examples without running them. Subtest names require executing the parent and do not appear. The test binary spelling is -test.list.

options.summary: Choose where test output files are written
options.detail: Relative profile names use this directory, which defaults to the go test working directory. On Go 1.26 and later it also contains saved test artifacts selected by -artifacts. The test binary spelling is -test.outputdir.

options.summary: Limit concurrency inside a test binary
options.detail: Defaults to GOMAXPROCS. Limits tests calling t.Parallel and simultaneous fuzz workers, even for fuzz targets without t.Parallel. Use -p to limit concurrent package binaries. The test binary spelling is -test.parallel.

options.summary: Ask long-running tests to shorten their work
options.detail: Code that checks testing.Short() can skip or reduce expensive work. Tests that ignore it continue normally. The test binary spelling is -test.short.

options.summary: Shuffle test and benchmark order
options.detail: Use on for a time-derived seed, off for normal order, or a signed decimal 64-bit seed to replay the order. Go prints the selected seed. The default is off. The test binary spelling is -test.shuffle.

options.summary: Exclude matching tests or benchmarks
options.detail: Exclude matching tests, examples, fuzz targets and benchmarks. Unbracketed / separates name expressions for successive test and benchmark levels. The test binary spelling is -test.skip.

options.summary: Choose vet checks for package tests
options.detail: Supply comma-separated analyzer names without spaces, for example -vet=printf,structtag. Use all for all installed checks or off to skip vet. Supply either special word on its own. An empty list restores the curated default.

options.summary: Report Go heap allocations in benchmarks
options.detail: Print bytes and allocations per operation. The counters exclude allocations made in C, including C.malloc. The test binary spelling is -test.benchmem.

options.summary: Write a goroutine blocking profile
options.detail: Records blocking sites and retains the compiled test binary. Adjust sampling with -blockprofilerate. Relative output filenames are resolved under -outputdir. The test binary spelling is -test.blockprofile.

options.summary: Set the blocking-profile sampling interval
options.detail: With -blockprofile, N targets one event per N nanoseconds spent blocked. 1 records every event, 0 disables sampling and a negative value leaves the runtime rate unchanged. The default with a profile is 1. The test binary spelling is -test.blockprofilerate.

options.summary: Write a CPU profile
options.detail: Collects a profile until the test process exits and retains the compiled test binary for go tool pprof. Relative output filenames are resolved under -outputdir. The test binary spelling is -test.cpuprofile.

options.summary: Write a memory allocation profile
options.detail: Records sampled allocations after the tests pass and retains the test binary. Adjust sampling with -memprofilerate. Relative output filenames are resolved under -outputdir. The test binary spelling is -test.memprofile.

options.summary: Set the allocation-profile sampling interval
options.detail: A positive N requests roughly one sample per N bytes allocated. Use 1 for every allocation. Zero and negative values leave the runtime rate unchanged. Its normal starting rate is 524288 bytes. The test binary spelling is -test.memprofilerate.

options.summary: Write a mutex contention profile
options.detail: Records mutex contention and retains the compiled test binary. Adjust sampling with -mutexprofilefraction. Relative output filenames are resolved under -outputdir. The test binary spelling is -test.mutexprofile.

options.summary: Set the mutex contention sampling fraction
options.detail: With -mutexprofile, collect roughly one in N contention events. The default 1 records all events. Zero disables sampling. Negative values leave the runtime setting unchanged. The test binary spelling is -test.mutexprofilefraction.

options.summary: Write an execution trace
options.detail: Writes runtime trace events before the test exits. Read the file with go tool trace. Relative output filenames are resolved under -outputdir. The test binary spelling is -test.trace.
